games.title: Halo 3
games.notes: Tester finished it with occlusion_query and readback_resolve set to fast; fast occlusion queries fix unoccluded lens flares.

games.title: Halo 3: ODST
games.notes: Tester on a ROG Xbox Ally X finished it with readback_resolve=full (fixes over-brightness) and occlusion_query=fast. ROV fixes decal flicker but is slow and crash-prone on AMD.

games.title: Halo: Reach
games.notes: readback_resolve=full avoids text corruption and brightness issues; leave query_occlusion_sample_lower_threshold at default to avoid AO flicker.

games.title: Red Dead Redemption
games.notes: occlusion_query=fast fixes unoccluded lens flares; a tester also capped FPS with framerate_limit. Ragdoll physics may differ at higher FPS.

games.title: Gears of War
games.notes: Use D3D12 (report says Vulkan still unstable). depth_bias_shader_offset=true fixed blood pools on NVIDIA but may not work on AMD.

games.title: Gears of War 2
games.notes: Maintainers recommend occlusion_query=strict for lens flares; the Black Shading Fix patch fixes black character textures.

games.title: Forza Horizon
games.notes: Tagged requires_mount_cache; readback_resolve=fast fixes green/purple car artifacts when upscaling. Stay at 1x (720p) scale on the Ally.

games.title: Skate 3
games.notes: xma_decoder=old and disabling the dedicated XMA thread fixed audio cut-out freezes; readback_resolve=fast fixes billboard photos (Edge build).

games.title: Lost Odyssey
games.notes: Character lighting flicker is fixed by ROV/FSI or the Character Lighting Fix patch; ROV is costly and can crash AMD shader compilers, so prefer the patch.

games.title: Ninja Gaiden II
games.notes: Tagged requires_clear_memory_page_state_true (fixes missing models in Team Ninja games); a tester set apu to xaudio2 to avoid audio cut-outs.

games.title: Blue Dragon
games.notes: Tagged requires_clear_memory_page_state_true; fur textures need render_target_path_d3d12=rov, which is slow and crash-prone on AMD GPUs.
